channel.title: Post-Quantum Payments Infrastructure: Why Banks May Replace Rather Than Retrofit Legacy Rails
channel.description: Post-quantum cryptography forces a binary choice on payment rails: retrofit RSA/ECC inside SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 envelopes that were never sized for ML-KEM and ML-DSA, or replace with crypto-agile infrastructure. Architects must decide before HNDL becomes operational loss.

item.title: Post-Quantum Payments Infrastructure: Why Banks May Replace Rather Than Retrofit Legacy Rails
item.description: ML-KEM and ML-DSA do not fit cleanly inside SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 envelopes built for RSA-2048. Harvest-now-decrypt-later compounds the timeline. The architectural answer is replacement on crypto-agile rails, not retrofit.
